properties.name: RECURRENCE (measured on flo2.io 0.92.0 and main 983811cae): a physical model's deliberately undischarged idealizations (8 req:assume-* plus the Beer-Lambert model) read in loop_status as "THE REASONING IS NOT AS STATED: 9 assumption(s) never discharged", while reasoning_report reads the same claims, correctly, as conditional. Same cause as the 10-25 chosen-principle finding, a third meaning of `assumed`, still unfixed on main
properties.source: loop_status and reasoning_report on flo2 design 066be35ae5418abb (reflow2 0.92.0), read-only; reflow2 main 983811cae detect.rs, report.rs
properties.statement:
OBSERVED (sinogram trial, 2026-10-27): loop_status reported the stated model assumptions as "THE REASONING IS NOT AS STATED".

MEASURED (read-only, design 066be35ae5418abb through the flo2 connector, reflow2 0.92.0): loop_status reasoning.undischarged_assumptions = 9, ids con:principle-beer-lambert, req:assume-axis-known, -enough-angles, -enough-counts, -ideal-detector, -monochromatic, -no-scatter, -parallel-beam, -stationary-sample; structural_defects 0. reasoning_report reads every claim "conditional ... which no step on the way to it discharges", which is what a physical model is.

PRECEDENT: reflow2:fact:a-chosen-principle-taken-up-as-assumed-raises-a-false-never-discharged-gap-2026-10-25 (legal-case trial F5): detect_reasoning_not_as_stated pushes a 0.5 gap for every assumption with no discharging step and never reads what the assumed node is. "Not built."

CODE at main 983811cae: detect.rs detect_reasoning_not_as_stated (line ~4650) is unchanged in substance since 0c567349c (the commits since touch the walk's stack, not this rule); its text still says an assumption is "a supposition for the sake of argument, an induction hypothesis"; report.rs ~1536 writes the loop_status line from r.undischarged_assumptions.

CANDIDATES: (1) the detector treats every undischarged `assumed` premise as an unfinished supposition. HOLDS, unchanged. (2) The trial misused `assumed`: model idealizations should be ordinary premises. REFUTED as a cause: as plain premises they would read "holds", which hides exactly what a model must keep visible; conditional is the right reading, and the phenomenon requirement says the assumptions stay undischarged on purpose. (3) Outside reflow2: flo2's door or persona block rewrote the message. REFUTED: the line is reflow2's format! text in report.rs. (4) The assumptions were Requirements, not statements with a statement_kind, and a kind would have exempted them. REFUTED: assumptions() reads no kind at all.

CLASS (as on 10-25): one property, `assumed`, now carries THREE meanings (a proof's supposition to discharge; an argument's chosen principle; a model's idealization held on purpose), and only the first has a reader. The legal trial and this one would both be fixed by the same change; fixing only "principle" would leave this.

FIX, ranked by correctness: (a) a step (or the assumed node) says how an assumption is held - `supposition` (must be discharged; today's gap), `principle` or `model` (held on purpose); only a supposition raises reasoning_not_as_stated; loop_status counts the others as "N standing assumptions, held on purpose" and reasoning_report keeps them in each claim's `assumes`; pinned by a test on a model with 2 idealizations where loop_status shows no NOT AS STATED line; (b) the 10-25 option, skip non-hypothesis kinds, which needs every writer to set statement_kind; (c) wording only. NOT ESTABLISHED: whether detect_gaps also raised 9 separate gaps on this design (31 unsurfaced gaps; not listed). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
